studentPortfolio.about:
Hi! I’m Jonathan, an aspiring cloud engineer and full-stack developer with a growing focus on scalable systems, cloud technologies, and modern API-driven architectures. I’m passionate about building secure, efficient, and reliable applications, and I aim to contribute to the development of responsible, impactful solutions that leverage cloud and emerging technologies. My goal is to design cloud infrastructures that empower data-driven systems and support real-world, high-value use cases.
Right now, most of my strengths are in frontend development, and I’m actively learning the backend and cloud technologies needed to advance toward my goal. I’m committed to continuous improvement and building a strong foundation to become a skilled cloud engineer in the future.
